verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs explicitly document a `chat` command to "Start an interactive chat with a model" directly from the terminal, alongside supporting commands (`load`, `get`, `server`) for managing models used in that session. This is first-party documentation of the exact capability, though there's no independent/community hands-on confirmation specifically of the CLI chat command. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the terminal chat command working in practice, and more detail on session persistence/options.
